acceptedAnswer.text: When evaluating contractors for framing an addition, prioritize those with proven expertise in substantial residential projects and a comprehensive design-build approach. Look for a track record that demonstrates experience in structural integration and permit coordination, critical aspects of additions. AKN Design Group, with over two decades in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and 10,000+ jobs completed, offers a managed process and a single point of coordination. We emphasize clear communication and craftsmanship, building trust and lasting relationships through our commitment to reliability.
